Slider persistence works: dp_drunkLevel restored after reload (thumb left=294px both before/after).
Menu pigeon strength scales visibly with slider (calm at TIPSY, heavy wobble + bubbles + HIC! at PIGEONED).
Playability confirmed: tap-to-flap responsive even under maximum drunk-screen overlay.
Pint boost not verifiable via automation — pigeon dies at 6m before any pint spawns in reach. Recommend main agent verify pint boost manually or add a debug seed.
